description: Attack-decay envelope whose peak can be raised or lowered by an accent, with the accent stepping through a set number of levels each time it fires or following the voltage that fires it

params.text: Sets the rise time, 1ms at fully counter-clockwise to 10 seconds at fully clockwise
Sets the fall time, 1ms at fully counter-clockwise to 10 seconds at fully clockwise
Bends both stages from a straight line at fully counter-clockwise to a curve at fully clockwise, the exponent chosen on the menu
Sets the peak the envelope reaches with no accent, 0 to 10V
Sets how many levels the accent steps through, -8 to 8; at 0 no accent is added, at 1 every accent is full, at 2 they alternate half and full, and a negative setting subtracts the accent instead
Sets how much of the headroom above the base level an accent may use, 0 to 1; with the base at 6V, a full setting adds up to 4V
Attenuates and inverts the ATT jack, -1 to 1, before that voltage is added to the ATTACK knob
Attenuates and inverts the DEC jack, -1 to 1, before that voltage is added to the DECAY knob
Flips the accent steps between climbing from the lowest level to the highest and falling the other way

inputs.text: Each rise past 1V starts the envelope
A voltage here at the moment of a trigger makes that envelope an accented one, and its size, 0V to 10V, scales how much accent is applied
Divided by 10, scaled by its attenuverter and added to the ATTACK knob
Divided by 10, scaled by its attenuverter and added to the DECAY knob
Each rise past 1V flips the accent steps between climbing and falling, which the panel button does too

outputs.text: The accent level of the envelope being played, 0V to 10V, before the ACCENT knob scales it, so an external signal can shape the accent with that knob at zero

notes: the module holds off for the Trigger Sync Delay before starting an envelope, so every envelope is late by that many samples; at the default that is five
every jack is monophonic, whatever is patched in
menu: Attack Curve: Logarithmic, Exponential — chooses which way the SHAPE knob bends the rising stage
Exponent Function: Quadratic, Cubic, Quartic — sets how sharp the curve the SHAPE knob reaches at its clockwise end is
Retrigger: Off, On — sets whether a trigger arriving during the fall restarts the envelope
Retrigger Strategy: I, II — I jumps straight to the fall of the new envelope and crossfades to avoid a click; II holds off until the new envelope's peak would be above the current level
Trigger Sync Delay: Off, 5 samples, 10 samples — sets how far apart the trigger and the accent may arrive and be taken as one hit

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.3:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
